# A. Duie Pyle Opens New Warehouse Facility, Creating a Fully Integrated Logistics Center in Central Pennsylvania 

 October 5, 2026 • 488 words 

The Northeast’s leading supply chain provider will now offer warehousing and LTL transportation services out of its Camp Hill site, giving customers faster, more flexible distribution across the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic and Ohio

WEST CHESTER, Pa. — October 5, 2026 — A. Duie Pyle (Pyle), a premier, 102-year-old family-owned and operated provider of asset and non-asset-based supply chain solutions, today announces the opening of a new warehouse facility in Camp Hill, Pennsylvania. Positioned directly adjacent to the company’s existing less-than-truckload (LTL) service center, the facility transforms the site into a fully integrated logistics center that brings warehousing and transportation operations together on one connected campus, providing customers with greater speed, flexibility and supply chain efficiency.

# FST Logistics Expands Central Ohio Presence with New West Jefferson, Ohio Facility 

Dublin, OH – FST Logistics, a leading third-party logistics provider specializing in temperature-controlled transportation, retail consolidation, warehousing and supply chain solutions, is proud to announce the expansion of its Central Ohio footprint with the opening of a new facility in West Jefferson, Ohio. The new location adds 343,500 square feet of warehouse space to FST’s growing network and strengthens the company’s ability to support customers’ growth throughout the Midwest and beyond. 

The expansion provides additional capacity for FST to support the evolving needs of its customers, while creating opportunities to serve new customers seeking strategic warehousing and distribution solutions in Central Ohio. The facility features 38 dock doors, two drive-in doors, 40-foot clear height, 254 parking spaces and 85 trailer parking spaces, providing the infrastructure and capacity needed to support a wide range of customer operations.

XPO Opens Two New Service Centers in Fast-Growing Freight

## Facilities in Arizona and Missouri Expand Capacity for Customers and Strengthen XPO’s North American Network

 October 01, 2026 07:45 ET | Source: XPO, Inc. 

GREENWICH, Conn., Oct. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- XPO (NYSE: XPO), a leading provider of freight transportation in North America, today announced the opening of two new service centers in Mesa, Arizona, and Cameron, Missouri. The facilities expand XPO’s capacity to meet growing freight demand in the Phoenix and Kansas City metropolitan areas. Matt Carroll, president of XPO’s West Division, said, “These new service centers deepen our presence in two critical freight markets and reflect our strategic approach to investing in our network. We’ve added capacity where our customers need it most, positioning us to support their growth while delivering the world-class service they count on.” The 51,000-square-foot Mesa facility has 86 dock doors and a team of more than 100 employees. # Seabird Logisolutions Opens New Warehouse Facility in Farrukhnagar, Gurugram

September 29, 2026

 

Seabird Logisolutions has expanded its warehousing and logistics infrastructure with the inauguration of a new warehouse facility at Farrukhnagar, Gurugram, Haryana, on September 25, 2026.

The new facility was formally inaugurated during an Opening Ceremony and Puja, attended by the company’s customers, partners, associates and team members.

Located in the revenue estate of Khurampur village, Tehsil Farrukhnagar, the facility is aimed at strengthening Seabird Logisolutions’ warehousing capacity and enhancing its ability to provide reliable and efficient logistics solutions to customers in the region.

The new warehouse provides additional space and stronger infrastructure, supporting the company’s continued focus on improving operational capabilities and serving its growing customer base.

The inauguration marks another milestone in Seabird Logisolutions’ expansion of its logistics and warehousing network in the Gurugram region.

WOODLAND DIRECT OPENS NEW DISTRIBUTION CENTER IN RENO, NV

Sep 04, 2026, 13:44 ET

AUBURN HILLS, Mich., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Woodland Direct, the nation's premier e-commerce site for fire products, is opening a new 47,000-square-foot distribution center in Reno, NV. This is the company's second distribution center, joining its world headquarters and distribution center in Auburn Hills, MI.

The new facility, officially opening in September, will improve the customer experience by shortening shipping times for West Coast customers.

 

 Woodland Direct's Reno Distribution Center 

"Woodland Direct has grown and evolved substantially over the past several years," said President and Founder Andrew Ingram. "We already ship all around the country. By opening the Reno distribution center, we're able to serve our West Coast customers more quickly and efficiently."

The leadership team began exploring the idea of opening a second distribution center in the final quarter of 2025. Woodland worked with logistics consultants to determine whether an expansion west of the Rocky Mountains made sense, and Reno's strategic location made it a natural choice for the expansion.

results.author: Meredith Chambliss
results.text:
RLX Officially Opens New Corporate Headquarters in Rock Hill | Riverstone Logistics

# RLX Officially Opens New Corporate Headquarters in Rock Hill 

New headquarters at The Thread marks a significant milestone in the company’s continued growth and commitment to community

 

ROCK HILL, S.C. – September 9, 2026 — Riverstone Logistics (RLX), a nationwide leader in logistics and supply chain solutions with more than 800 employees across the country, today celebrated the official opening of its new corporate headquarters in Rock Hill, South Carolina, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony at The Thread.

The opening marks a significant milestone for Riverstone Logistics as the company establishes its roots in Rock Hill following its relocation from Charlotte, North Carolina. The new headquarters brings more than 150 RLX employees to a 40,000-square-foot space designed to support collaboration, innovation and the continued growth of the company’s nationwide operations.

“Relocating our headquarters to Rock Hill is more than a business decision – it’s an opportunity to plant roots, create opportunities and become part of a community where we can build something meaningful,” said Charlie Workmon
